annotations.title: Plan where to put an amount

description: A ranked menu of 3 to 6 yield options on Sui for an amount: the realized APY used (never the advertised one), expected USD over the horizon, cost to get in and out at that size, risk tier with reasons, plain steps and links. Ranks options that reach target_apy first, then lowest risk. With build: true and sender it also returns the unsigned transaction for the top option, already dry-run and checked, ready for the wallet to sign. Example: { amount_usd: 5000, asset: "USDC", target_apy: 6, max_risk_tier: 2, build: true, sender: "0x..." }.

amount.description: With build: amount of asset in whole coins. Default amount_usd at today's price.

asset.description: The coin held: a symbol (USDC, SUI) or coin type.

build.description: Also build the unsigned transaction for the top option (or build_ranks), checked on current mainnet state. Needs sender.

build_ranks.description: With build: option ranks to build, default [1], at most 3.

horizon_days.description: Days you plan to stay, default 365.

max_risk_tier.description: Highest risk tier to accept, 1 (lowest) to 5. For the lowest risk, pass 1 or 2.

pass.description: With build: an Agent Pass id instead of sender; builds for the pass's agent within the owner's rules, with a signed receipt.

sender.description: With build: the wallet that holds asset and will sign.

slippage_pct.description: With build: slippage for a swap into the option's coin, percent, default 0.5.

name: yield_plan
